messages.早めに猛虎標弾へ切り替えて、天退星と破壊不能コイン、強化S3「超絶猛虎殺撃乱斬」: A Thumb Identity that wants to switch to Savage Tigermark Rounds early and attack through Tiantui Star [天退星], Unbreakable Coins, and enhanced S3 Savage Tigerslayer's Perfected Flurry of Blades [超絕猛虎殺擊亂斬]. Manage ammunition so the Overheat period after running dry does not coincide with the decisive phase of battle.
messages.猛虎標弾への切り替え: 最初は虎標弾12発を持つ。戦闘で初めて守備スキルを装着す: **Switching to Savage Tigermark Rounds**: He starts with 12 Tigermark Rounds. The first time in a battle he equips a Defense skill, runs out of Tigermark Rounds, or is staggered, he loads 8 Savage Tigermark Rounds at the end of that turn and gains Tiantui Star [天退星] (once per battle; any remaining Tigermark Rounds disappear). Equipping a Defense skill lets him switch without waiting to fire off all Tigermark Rounds.
messages.猛虎標弾の間の強さ: バトルパッシブ「天退星刀」(怠惰×3・保有・同期化Ⅱで取得: **Strength while on Savage Tigermark Rounds**: Through the combat passive Tiantui Star's Blade [天退星刀] (3 Sloth Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ), all Coins of his basic attack skills become Unbreakable while he has at least 1 Savage Tigermark Round. Coins that spend Savage Tigermark Rounds gain +2 Coin Power, +30% damage, and +2 Burn inflicted. S3 becomes the 5-Coin Savage Tigerslayer's Perfected Flurry of Blades [超絕猛虎殺擊亂斬], which uses 3 Savage Tigermark Rounds per use.
messages.弾数の管理: 猛虎標弾の最後の1発を撃つ基本攻撃スキルは、攻撃加重値+2になる。: **Ammo management**: The basic attack skill that fires the last Savage Tigermark Round gains +2 Attack Weight. The Defense skill I'm Burning Up. uses no ammo. Adjust the ammo spent by other skills so the enhanced S3 fires the last rounds.
messages.オーバーヒート(避けたい状態): 猛虎標弾を撃ち切った次のターンに得る。速度は上: **Overheat (a state to avoid)**: Gained on the turn after firing off all Savage Tigermark Rounds. His Speed rises, but his basic attack skills lose Clash Power equal to (total rounds spent ÷ 2), up to 10. It is a major weakening, so keep it from overlapping with a boss's critical phase.
messages.振動と火傷: 各スキルで振動と火傷を付与し、S3は振動-灼熱へ変換して振動爆発す: **Tremor and Burn**: Each skill inflicts Tremor and Burn, and S3 converts into Tremor - Scorch and triggers Tremor Burst. If ammo was spent, an additional Tremor Burst is triggered.
messages.序盤に守備を装着して猛虎標弾に切り替え、破壊不能コインと強化S3で一気に攻める。: Equip a Defense skill early to switch to Savage Tigermark Rounds, then attack hard with Unbreakable Coins and the enhanced S3. There are only 8 Savage Tigermark Rounds, so allocate them so the enhanced S3 uses up the last rounds, and time Overheat to match the flow of battle.
